description: Find WhyIsMy.org's free ten-question quizzes (health, tech, cars, home and eldercare topics) with instant explanations and a certificate of completion. Both arguments are optional: omit everything to browse, pass query and/or category to narrow. Each result is a one-line teaser plus a link — a quiz is interactive and scores the user in their own browser, so send the user to the URL to take it instead of answering the questions yourself.

category.description: Optional category name to filter, e.g. "Skin", "Dental", "Finance".

query.description: What the user wants to be quizzed on, e.g. "itchy skin" or "medicaid look-back".

name: list_quizzes
title: Find WhyIsMy.org quizzes
